reason: H0 only parses inputs with pixReadMemSpix, while the changed src/tiffio.c behavior rounds TIFF resolution values through fxres, fyres, pxres, and pyres. Thus H0 does not exercise the changed TIFF metadata behavior. However, this reachability gap already existed under S0: the commit only changes truncation to rounding in an existing code path and does not add an entry point, protocol, state, configuration, or attack surface. The gap was therefore neither introduced nor materially aggravated by this commit.
evidence: Both pix3_fuzzer.cc and barcode_fuzzer.cc construct their input PIX with pixReadMemSpix(data, size).
The only production change is in src/tiffio.c, changing (l_int32)fxres and (l_int32)fyres to (l_int32)(fxres + 0.5) and (l_int32)(fyres + 0.5).
The resunit == RESUNIT_CENTIMETER branch and the surrounding resolution-conversion control flow are unchanged.
No H0 entry point consumes TIFF-formatted bytes or directly controls fxres, fyres, or resunit.
The same absence of TIFF input reachability applies to S0 + H0 and S1 + H0.
recommended_action: No commit-specific harness maintenance is needed. TIFF-focused fuzz coverage could be added as independent historical coverage improvement, but it should not be attributed to this commit.
